How to get it :
- [[Assembly Machine|Assembly Machine]] : 2 x [[gv:plate_polymer|Insulator]], 2 x [[gv:circuit_silicon|Printed Silicon Wafer]], nugget (bismoid), 2 x wire (Gold).
- [[gv:machine_precass|Precision Assembly Machine]] : 4 x [[gv:circuit_silicon|Printed Silicon Wafer]], 8 x [[gv:plate_polymer|Insulator]], 2 x nugget (bismoid), 4 x wire (Gold), 500 mB Perfluoromethyl.

Used to make :
[[Vacuum Refinery|Vacuum Refinery]], [[gv:circuit_controller_advanced|Advanced Control Unit]], [[gv:circuit_controller_quantum|Quantum Computer]], [[gv:circuit_bismoid|Versatile Circuit Board]], [[gv:circuit_quantum|Quantum Processing Unit]].
